takeaway: Basal cell carcinoma is treated by curettage and cautery, cryotherapy, excision or watch and wait. Sentinel node biopsy belongs to melanoma, not BCC.

question.text: Which one of the following is not a recognized treatment option for basal cell carcinoma?

lines.text: This pearly bump is basal cell carcinoma. Let us check each treatment.
So is cryotherapy, but it treats the lesion and gives no tissue for histology.
Surgical excision gives a specimen for histology, a closed wound, and proof of complete excision.
Larger lesions may need a skin graft or reconstructive surgery.
Watch and wait is also an accepted option.
Sentinel node biopsy is part of the treatment options for melanoma, not basal cell carcinoma.
So the answer is sentinel node biopsy.
